info.syllabusName: Phân tích  chuỗi cung ứng (Supply Chain Analytics)
info.description: This course equips final-year undergraduates with advanced knowledge and practical skills in applying data analytics to supply chain management. Using real-world datasets, performance metrics, and emerging technologies, students will evaluate supply chain strategies, develop sustainable planning approaches, and design innovative solutions using advanced tools such as AI, Big Data, IoT, and blockchain.
info.decisionNo: Ban hành theo QĐ CTĐT TDTU

clos.loDetails: Provide students with knowledge of analytical frameworks, KPIs, and performance evaluation methods in supply chains
Able to apply forecasting, optimization, and risk management techniques to real-world supply chain challenges
Able to design innovative, technology-enabled supply chain solutions for sustainable global competitiveness
